{{Short description|Dutch physicist (1942–2020)}}
'''Johannes Petrus''' '''"Han"''' '''Woerdman''' (29 November 1942 – 18 August 2020) was a Dutch physicist. He was a researcher at [[Philips Natuurkundig Laboratorium]] and later professor at [[Leiden University]].

==Life==
Woerdman was born on 29 November 1942 in [[Laren, North Holland]].<ref name=lu>{{cite web|author= |url=https://hoogleraren.leidenuniv.nl/id/2815 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200825165553/https://hoogleraren.leidenuniv.nl/id/2815 |title=Johannes Petrus Woerdman (Han) |language=Dutch |publisher=Leiden University |date= |archive-date=25 August 2020}}</ref> In 1968 he started working at [[Philips Natuurkundig Laboratorium]].<ref name=casi>{{cite web|author= |url=https://casimir.researchschool.nl/in-memoriam-han-woerdman-4861.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200825171602/https://casimir.researchschool.nl/in-memoriam-han-woerdman-4861.html |title=In memoriam: Han Woerdman
|publisher=Casimir Research School |date=20 August 2020 |archive-date=25 August 2020}}</ref> He obtained his PhD in mathematics at the University of Amsterdam in 1971 under {{ill|Andries Rinse Miedema|nl|Andries Rinse Miedema}} with a thesis titled: ''Some optical and electrical properties of a laser-generated free-carrier plasma in Si.''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.albumacademicum.uva.nl/cgi/b/bib/bib-idx?type=simple;lang=nl;c=ap;rgn1=entirerecord;q1=Woerdman;x=0;y=0;cc=ap;view=reslist;sort=achternaam;fmt=long;page=reslist;start=1;size=1 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200825165235/http://www.albumacademicum.uva.nl/cgi/b/bib/bib-idx?type=simple&lang=nl&c=ap&rgn1=entirerecord&q1=Woerdman&x=0&y=0&cc=ap&view=reslist&sort=achternaam&fmt=long&page=reslist&start=1&size=1 |title=J.P. Woerdman |language=Dutch |publisher=University of Amsterdam |date= |archive-date=25 August 2020}}</ref> In 1983 he left Philips and was appointed professor of experimental physics at Leiden University.<ref name=lu/> 

At Leiden University Woerdman performed research into lasers and optics, specializing in [[Optics#Classical optics|classical optics]].<ref name=casi/> He was responsible for building the field of [[quantum optics]] at the university.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://images.nrc.nl/8i4D4nEE7XAjINBpSCU3X43w_nM=/x/filters:no_upscale():format(jpeg):fill(f8f8f8,true)/s3/nrchub/clippings/NH/20200825/304-advertisement-216062_1269430_woerdman10-b66b98.png |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200825174336/https://images.nrc.nl/8i4D4nEE7XAjINBpSCU3X43w_nM=/x/filters:no_upscale%28%29:format%28jpeg%29:fill%28f8f8f8,true%29/s3/nrchub/clippings/NH/20200825/304-advertisement-216062_1269430_woerdman10-b66b98.png |title=Overlijdensbericht Prof. Dr. J.P. (Han) Woerdman |language=Dutch |publisher=NRC Handelsblad |date=25 August 2020 |archive-date=25 August 2020}}</ref> In 2020 one of the articles he contributed to in 1992 was chosen as one of three classics of ''[[Physical Review A]]''.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.uva.nl/shared-content/subsites/institute-of-physics/nl/nieuws/2020/03/donut-modes-artikel-van-robert-spreeuw-gekozen-tot-pra-classic.html?origin=C7qo0vSuQiCeMfPYaosIew |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200825173101/https://www.uva.nl/shared-content/subsites/institute-of-physics/nl/nieuws/2020/03/donut-modes-artikel-van-robert-spreeuw-gekozen-tot-pra-classic.html?origin=C7qo0vSuQiCeMfPYaosIew |title="Donut modes"-artikel van Robert Spreeuw gekozen tot PRA classic |language=Dutch |publisher=University of Amsterdam |date=15 March 2020 |archive-date=25 August 2020}}</ref>

Woerdman was elected a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 2002.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/5304 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200808001234/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/5304 |title=Han Woerdman |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=8 August 2020}}</ref> In 2007 he was named a Fellow of the [[European Optical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.engineersonline.nl/nieuws/id8511-eos-fellowship-2007-voor-ad-lagendijk-en-han-woerdman-.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200825173533/https://www.engineersonline.nl/nieuws/id8511-eos-fellowship-2007-voor-ad-lagendijk-en-han-woerdman-.html |title=EOS Fellowship 2007 voor Ad Lagendijk en Han Woerdman |language=Dutch |publisher=engineersonline.nl |date=27 July 2007 |archive-date=25 August 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.europeanoptics.org/pages/distinctions/eos-fellows.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200613233341/https://www.europeanoptics.org/pages/distinctions/eos-fellows.html |title=EOS fellows |publisher=European Optical Society |date= |archive-date=13 June 2020}}</ref> In 2010 he was diagnosed with [[Parkinson's disease]], which caused his death on 18 August 2020 at the age of 77.<ref name=casi/>
